description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha (local authority) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacant seat, which falls under the Elections classification (Type 7).
